pages.title: Overview
pages.text:
The Sea Armor set — Current Helmet, Abyssal Chestplate, Tide Leggings, and Surf Boots.

Combined stats
• Defense 20: helmet 3 / chestplate 8 / leggings 6 / boots 3
• Toughness 2.0, knockback resistance 0
• Enchantability 10, durability base 33
• Equip sound: turtle shell
• Can be trimmed with trimming templates on a smithing table

pages.title: How to Obtain
pages.text:
The Sea Armor has no crafting recipe; it is found only in Buried Treasure:
• 91% chance to contain Sea Armor
• 2-4 non-duplicate pieces appear when it does
• Random durability per piece; 50% chance of a random enchantment

Repair
Prismarine shards or nautilus shells repair the Sea Armor on an anvil.

pages.title: Set Effects
pages.text:
Equipping the full Sea Armor set grants the power of the deep; all effects apply to the wearer:

• Surf Boots: walk, run, and jump on water; hold Sneak (Shift) to sink and swim freely — resurfacing restores the water-walking effect. High-speed falls into water avoid fall damage (only negated when falling onto water; land falls are not).
• Current Helmet: infinite Water Breathing.
• Abyssal Chestplate: clear underwater vision; night vision removes underwater darkness.
• Tide Leggings: significantly faster swimming in water; also enable the "water clutch" trick (see next page).

pages.title: Tide Leggings: Water Clutch
pages.text:
While wearing Tide Leggings, and when you:
• are holding Sneak (Shift) to crouch
• have a fall distance over 3.5 blocks (about to take fall damage)

the leggings automatically place a water source beneath your feet, so you land safely without injury; the water disappears once you are safe.

Each clutch trigger costs 1 durability on the leggings.

**Tip:** Keep holding Shift while falling from high up and the leggings will keep cushioning you all the way down.

pages.title: Full Set & Doll
pages.text:
• Gaining Resistance II constantly when wearing all four pieces.
• Each Sea Armor piece worn by a doll increases its outgoing damage by 10%; four pieces total 40%, and the effect stacks.
